normalization_plan.reason: The recipient address parameter has no independent security meaning and can be folded into the transfer entry point.
The amount parameter only participates in the transfer balance update and belongs to the transfer function node.
The spender parameter is only used as the allowed mapping key inside approve.
The allowance value parameter is fully described by the approve function node.
The destination address parameter only affects the transferFrom balance update.
The amount parameter is fully captured by the transferFrom function semantics.
The caller-supplied token address is the target of the external call and is best represented by that unsafe operation node.
The proposed owner parameter only flows into the newOwner state variable via transferOwnership.
The spender parameter is the untrusted call target of the external receiveApproval invocation.
The approved amount is passed through the external callback and is subsumed by the external call node.
The arbitrary bytes payload is forwarded to the external callback and is represented by the unsafe operation.
